purpose_context: Felix resolves Vikunja projects and labels ad-hoc today — by title in some places, hardcoded ids in others, with no single mapping. That fragility silently broke inbox routing when the #714 Vikunja reset deleted a project (#743). This mission consolidates all project/label resolution into one declared seam that resolves against the locked post-reset names and fails loud on drift, so Felix stays correct across Vikunja structure changes and the downstream routing/atomicity/validation work (#745/#746/#749) builds on solid ground.
purpose_tldr: One declared, validated source of truth for how Felix resolves Vikunja projects and labels, so structure changes don't silently break routing.
